name: Klamath County, OR
findings: Klamath County has 257 nonprofit organizations. 95 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 74 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Klamath County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 12 hobby and sports organizations here list membership, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.
